title: Novella & Presenza
subtitle: Library Management System | Attendance Management System
description: Novella & Presenza is a unified administrative ecosystem that integrates two distinct but interconnected platforms: 'Novella,' a comprehensive Library Management System, and 'Presenza,' an automated Attendance Management System. The end-to-end development lifecycle was directed from project planning and scope to full-scale module implementation and core system logic. Development of these integrated systems involved analyzing complex workflows and translating requirements into effective technical solutions, while also heading the frontend development and UI design to transform prototypes into a responsive, high-performance interface with robust field validations. Built upon a shared data architecture, these systems operate as a single integrated unit, allowing for seamless synchronization of user data and activity logs. This integration eliminates data silos, ensuring that a user's library interactions and facility attendance records are linked within a centralized hub. By bridging these two domains, the platform enables administrators to conduct cross-module reporting, gain holistic insights into facility utilization, and minimize manual data reconciliation.

features.name: Integrated System Architecture
features.description: A centralized data hub that links Novella and Presenza, ensuring real-time synchronization of user profiles and operational logs.

features.name: Intelligent Book Cataloging
features.description: Full CRUD management for library collections, including dynamic categorization, real-time stock status, and shelf-location tracking.

features.name: Smart Attendance Tracking
features.description: High-efficiency time-in/time-out logging for employees and visitors, providing an accurate, timestamped trail of facility usage.

features.name: Unified Data Architecture
features.description: Ensures data integrity across both modules, preventing duplicate profiles and allowing for cross-referenced reporting between library and attendance data.

features.name: Operational Analytics
features.description: Centralized reporting tools that visualize facility traffic, resource circulation trends, and peak occupancy hours to assist in data-driven planning.

title: ITECHTIONARY
subtitle: IT Dictionary Mobile Application
description: ITECHTIONARY is a specialized mobile reference application designed to serve as a comprehensive glossary for the IT industry. End-to-end development was directed using FlutterFlow and Firebase to build a categorized dictionary application for IT students. System architecture and categorization logic were designed to ensure efficient information retrieval and an intuitive learning experience. Furthermore, the full SDLC was managed by bridging the gap between Firebase backend infrastructure and a high-performance mobile interface, while technical documentation and database schemas were authored to establish a robust foundation for system reliability and future scalability. The application provides students and professionals with instant access to a vast database of technical terminology, ranging from software development and networking to cybersecurity and hardware engineering, aiming to bridge the knowledge gap by offering clear, concise definitions that ensure complex technical jargon is easily understandable for users at any skill level.

features.name: Comprehensive IT Glossary

features.name: Advanced Search & Filtering

features.name: Personalized Library

features.name: Cloud-Synced Data
